in_marathi.name: Charishma
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charishma हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Charishma is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'charis', which means 'radiance' or 'shining'. It is often associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and fortune. In Hindu mythology, Lakshmi is believed to bestow her blessings upon those who live a virtuous and righteous life.
